definition: A session is quarantined when its wrist IMU is inconsistent with its camera rotation: gyro-vs-pose angular-velocity agreement (c8_regress_ref208.gyro_check, video_to_cori_index_v1 applied) has per-session median vector cosine ~0 while every other session is 0.92-0.98, together with collapsed (mostly negative) IMU-VI scales. Sensor-integrity violation, NOT a yield-based exclusion (bimanual E of these sessions = 0).
reporting: report BOTH raw census and integrity-filtered census
